01 / The challenge

The challenge for window cleaners.

Window cleaning vans are often parked in the same streets every few weeks, which makes them ideal for building local recognition. Water-fed pole systems and tanks inside mean the windows may be blocked, so the panels do the talking.

01

Regular rounds

The same streets see your van every month. Repetition builds recognition if the design is memorable.

02

Poles on the roof

Ladders and pole racks cover part of the sides.

03

Extra services

Gutter, fascia and conservatory cleaning are worth mentioning.

Before you book

Good to know.

Will the graphics cope with water-fed systems?

Yes. Vinyl is waterproof. We recommend a laminate for vans that get wet daily.

Can I add a QR code for booking?

Yes, as long as it is big enough to scan and placed on the rear or side.

Can you match my existing logo?

Yes. Send your logo files and we will build the design around it.
